instruction.zh: 双脚起跳同时手脚张开，落地并拢；保持节奏，呼吸均匀。
instruction.en: Jump while spreading arms and legs wide, then land together; keep the rhythm and breathe evenly.

instruction.zh: 原地快速交替将膝盖抬至髋部高度，摆臂配合，核心收紧。
instruction.en: Quickly alternate driving knees up to hip height in place, pump arms and engage your core.

instruction.zh: 双臂侧平举，向前做大圈环绕 20 秒，再反向向后 20 秒。
instruction.en: Arms out to the sides, make large forward circles for 20s, then reverse to backward circles for another 20s.

instruction.zh: 双脚与肩同宽，下蹲至大腿约平行地面即起身，注意膝盖对齐脚尖。
instruction.en: Feet shoulder-width, squat until thighs roughly parallel then stand; keep knees tracking over toes.

instruction.zh: 四足跪姿，吸气抬头塌腰（牛），呼气弓背低头（猫），缓慢交替。
instruction.en: On hands and knees, inhale arching back lifting head (cow), exhale rounding back tucking chin (cat); alternate slowly.

instruction.zh: 双手叉腰，以髋为轴顺时针画大圈 20 秒，再逆时针 20 秒。
instruction.en: Hands on hips, rotate pelvis clockwise in large circles for 20s, then counter-clockwise for 20s.

instruction.zh: 高平板姿势，保持手臂伸直，只靠肩胛骨收缩下沉再推起。
instruction.en: High plank with straight arms, lower by retracting shoulder blades only, then push back up protracting.

instruction.zh: 仰卧屈膝，双脚踩地，臀部发力顶起身体至肩髋膝成一线。
instruction.en: Lie on your back with knees bent, drive through heels to lift hips until body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.

instruction.zh: 坐姿一条腿伸直，另一条腿弯曲贴大腿，上身前倾至腿后有牵拉感保持。
instruction.en: Sit with one leg straight, the other bent with foot against inner thigh; hinge forward from hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh, hold.

instruction.zh: 单脚站立，手拉另一只脚的脚背贴臀部，膝盖对齐，感受大腿前侧牵拉。
instruction.en: Stand on one leg, pull the top of the other foot toward your glutes; keep knees close together and feel the stretch on the front thigh.

instruction.zh: 小臂贴门框或墙面，身体前倾感受胸部牵拉，打开肩膀。
instruction.en: Place forearm on a wall or doorframe, lean forward until you feel a stretch across the chest and front of the shoulder.

instruction.zh: 跪坐，上身前倾贴大腿，双臂前伸或放身体两侧，放松背部。
instruction.en: Kneel with big toes touching, sit back onto heels and fold forward; rest arms extended or alongside body, relax the back.

instruction.zh: 四足跪姿，慢速交替做弓背（呼气）和塌腰（吸气），活动整段脊柱。
instruction.en: On hands and knees, slowly alternate rounding the back up (exhale) and arching it down (inhale) to mobilize the entire spine.

instruction.zh: 一臂水平横过胸前，另一手臂在肘窝处拉向身体，20 秒/侧。
instruction.en: Bring one arm horizontally across the chest, hook the other arm around the elbow and pull toward the body; 20s per side.

instruction.zh: 一手高举过头弯肘向后，另一手握住手肘轻轻下拉，20 秒/侧。
instruction.en: Raise one arm overhead and bend elbow behind your head; use the other hand to gently pull the elbow down; 20s per side.

name.zh: 站立侧弯腰方肌/背阔肌拉伸

instruction.zh: 双脚站立，一手上举过头弯向对侧侧屈，感受背部和侧腰牵拉。
instruction.en: Stand tall, raise one arm overhead and side-bend to the opposite side; feel the stretch along the lats and side body.

instruction.zh: 单膝跪地，前腿弓步，重心前移下压，感受髋前部牵拉，30 秒/侧。
instruction.en: Kneel on one knee with front leg in a lunge, shift hips forward and sink down; feel the stretch on the front of the hip, 30s per side.

instruction.zh: 放松肩膀，缓慢做颈部顺时针和逆时针的轻柔环绕，避免用力。
instruction.en: Relax shoulders, slowly roll the neck in gentle circles clockwise then counter-clockwise; no force.
